sources.title: soar/README.md · AEmotionStudio/dots-tts-models at main
sources.snippet: This repository hosts dots.tts-soar — the pretrained backbone further refined with Self-corrective Alignment (SCA), a reward-free flow-matching-native post-training stage. SCA pushes the model to the highest zero-shot fidelity and speaker similarity of the three releases and is the recommended default for production zero-shot voice cloning.

sources.title: dots.tts-soar: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: A: Both are valid. Use dots.tts-soar if you want to inherit its tightened text/timbre alignment and apply additional custom voice fine-tuning on top. Use dots.tts-base if you want maximum flexibility over sampling parameters and plan significant architectural experimentation. Q: What is the difference between dots.tts-soar and dots.tts-mf?

sources.title: dots.tts Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We present dots.tts, a 2B-parameter continuous autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) foundation model that models speech in a continuous latent space. Compared with existing continuous autoregressive models, our key innovations are threefold.
